articles.summary: Warm weather remains a leading draw for prospective homebuyers considering a move in retirement, but family connections are playing an equally important role among those already retired, according to a new PulteGroup survey of 1,330 prospective homebuyers at or nearing retirement age. Among respondents who are still working and considering an out-of-state move, 62% chose weather and climate as one of their top two reasons, followed by affordability and cost of living at 47% each and proximity to family or friends at 35%. Among those already retired, however, family connections carried greater weight. Forty-five percent of retired respondents considering an out-of-state move selected proximity to family or friends, tied with weather and climate as the leading considerations. While the survey does not track how individuals’ priorities change over time, it reveals differences in what working and retired prospective buyers emphasize when considering an out-of-state move. articles.summary: PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM) announced today that its Board of Directors has voted to increase the Company’s quarterly dividend by 4% to $0.27 per common share. The increase will be effective with the Company’s next scheduled dividend, which is payable January 5, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026. “PulteGroup’s diversified operating platform and disciplined business practices continue to help us navigate today’s more competitive market conditions,” said PulteGroup President and CEO, Ryan Marshall. “The decision to raise PulteGroup’s dividend for a ninth consecutive year reflects our business’s solid earnings and cash flow, which are continuing to support high returns and a strong balance sheet.” About PulteGroup PulteGroup, Inc.
